name: Mindcat Inbox
description_en:
Mindcat Inbox is a managed shared-conversation application currently positioned for real estate brokerages in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Agents answer from a company WhatsApp number, with ownership, notes and lead context kept alongside the conversation. Website chat and other connected channels can join that work queue; it is primarily the customer-conversation layer rather than a complete real estate listings system.

Its setup service is a material part of the product. Hosting mode, agent count, the company's Meta number, lead fields and integrations determine what is delivered. The current page distinguishes features available now from work performed during setup and labels its screenshots and examples as invented sample data. This profile preserves those conditions and explains the advertised pricing model without treating vendor examples, compliance fields or regional hosting statements as independently audited results.
description_zh:
Mindcat Inbox 是托管的共享沟通应用，目前主要面向阿联酋及沙特的房产经纪团队。坐席通过公司 WhatsApp 号码回复，沟通旁保存负责人、备注及线索背景。网页聊天和其他已连接渠道可汇入同一队列；它主要负责客户沟通层，而非完整房源管理系统。

实施服务是产品的重要组成。部署方式、坐席数、公司的 Meta 号码、线索字段和集成决定实际交付。当前页面区分现在已有能力和配置期间完成的工作，并明确截图及示例使用虚构数据。本文保留这些条件，解释宣传计价模型，不将厂商示例、合规字段或地区托管说明当作独立审计结论。

core_features.explanation_en: Assign conversations to agents and retain history and lead context with the brokerage.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分配沟通给坐席，并让历史及线索背景保留在经纪公司。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure area, budget, listing references and checking notes next to the chat.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在聊天旁配置区域、预算、房源编号及核对备注。

core_features.name_zh: 网页聊天与已批准模板群发
core_features.explanation_en: Website inquiries join the inbox; WhatsApp campaigns use approved templates and return replies to the shared queue.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网站咨询进入收件箱；WhatsApp 活动使用已批准模板，回复回到共享队列。

core_features.name_zh: 依赖实施的 CRM 交接
core_features.explanation_en: Salesforce lead sync and Slack connections are configured during setup; direct portal-feed scope has team-size conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: Salesforce 线索同步和 Slack 连接在实施时配置；门户直接数据流有团队规模条件。

en: Route a property inquiry to an available agent without losing the company conversation history.
Keep customer-facing replies separate from internal listing-check notes.
zh: 把房产咨询交给可接手坐席，并保留公司沟通历史。
区分面向客户的回复和内部房源核对备注。

faq.question_en: Does Inbox replace Salesforce or a real estate listings CRM?
faq.question_zh: Inbox 是否替代 Salesforce 或房源 CRM？
faq.answer_en: The vendor says it handles conversations while listings remain in the real estate CRM; Salesforce lead sync is setup work.
faq.answer_zh: 厂商说明其处理沟通，房源仍在房产 CRM 中；Salesforce 线索同步属于实施工作。

faq.question_en: Is choosing a Saudi region proof of regulatory compliance?
faq.question_zh: 选择沙特区域是否证明符合法规？
faq.answer_en: No. The vendor security page explicitly describes a scoping method rather than certification or legal advice. Verify the contracted system and every data recipient.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。厂商安全页明确说明这是界定范围的方法，而非认证或法律建议；需核对合同系统及每个数据接收方。

sections.title_en: A property inquiry stays with the company
sections.en:
Imagine a buyer enquiring about a listing while its assigned agent is at a viewing. The documented model places the chat on the company number, assigns an owner and shows listing reference, area and budget beside it. Another authorized agent can take over with the history rather than starting from a private phone thread. This is a hypothetical workflow, not an observed brokerage deployment.

Keep the customer reply and internal note separate in a pilot. Check that the manager can find an unassigned inquiry and that switching an agent's login off does not lose the conversation. The product FAQ describes reassignment after departure; no access-control or offboarding behavior was executed here.
sections.zh:
假设买家咨询房源时，原负责坐席正在带看。文档模型将沟通放在公司号码下，指定负责人，并在旁边显示房源编号、区域和预算。其他获授权坐席可带着历史接手，无需从私人手机聊天重新开始。这是假设流程，不是观察到的经纪公司部署。

试点时应区分客户回复和内部备注，检查经理能否找到未分配咨询，以及关闭坐席登录后会否丢失沟通。产品 FAQ 描述离职后的重新分配，但本文未实际运行权限或离职处理。

sections.title_en: Identify what is configured rather than already connected
sections.title_zh: 区分配置交付与已经连接
sections.en:
The page states website chat is available and portal inquiries can arrive via WhatsApp; a direct portal feed is built during setup for teams of 21 agents and above. Salesforce lead sync is also built during setup. Slack alerts, additional channels, fields and saved replies need the agreed connection/configuration. Do not describe every portal name as a ready-made universal connector.

Inbox is the shared-conversation layer. The broader WhatsApp services page describes AI-agent work that can write to Salesforce, Inbox or an ERP, which should be scoped separately. Request a field-level handoff example and clarify whether later edits, duplicates and failures propagate. Those exact synchronization and recovery semantics remain untested.
sections.zh:
页面说明网页聊天已可用，门户咨询可经 WhatsApp 到达；门户直接数据流则在实施时为21坐席及以上团队建立。Salesforce 线索同步也在实施时构建。Slack 提醒、其他渠道、字段及保存回复需按约定完成连接／配置，不能把每个门户名称写成普遍可用的现成连接器。

Inbox 属于共享沟通层；更广的 WhatsApp 服务页还描述可向 Salesforce、Inbox 或 ERP 写入的 AI 代理工作，需要另行界定范围。应要求展示字段级交接，并明确后续编辑、重复和失败是否传播。准确同步及恢复语义未经过测试。

sections.title_en: Checking fields and localization have limits
sections.title_zh: 核对字段与本地化均有边界
sections.en:
The advertised permit, QR and licence fields record what an agent checked. The FAQ explicitly says the product does not query DLD/REGA to validate the listing and does not submit goAML reports. This profile therefore does not turn those fields into a regulatory-compliance certification or repeat legal cash thresholds as verified law.

Arabic UI support is partial: agents can select right-to-left Arabic, with some screens still English and additional localization performed during setup. The FAQ says single sign-on is not included today. Verify the screens and login process your actual team uses. Chinese research text here does not establish a Chinese product interface.
sections.zh:
宣传的许可、二维码及执照字段记录坐席已经做过的检查。FAQ 明确说明产品不会查询 DLD／REGA 验证房源，也不会提交 goAML 报告。因此本文不把这些字段写成法规合规认证，也不将页面的现金阈值当作已核实法律重复传播。

阿拉伯语界面只完成一部分：坐席可选择从右向左的阿拉伯语，但部分屏幕仍是英文，其他本地化在实施期间完成。FAQ 说明当前不含单点登录，应核对实际团队所用屏幕及登录流程。本文中文研究也不代表产品支持中文界面。

sections.title_en: Marginal agent bands, deployment minima and setup
sections.title_zh: 分段坐席价、部署最低费用与实施
sections.en:
An agent is someone who replies to customers that month; one report-only owner/admin login is free. The shared plan bills marginal bands: first five at AED/SAR89 each, agents 6–20 at 59, 21–50 at 45 and above 50 at 35. Thus 12 shared agents produce 5 × 89 + 7 × 59 = 858 per month, rather than applying the lower band to all twelve. The shared minimum is three agents.

Dedicated vendor-hosted copies double agent prices with an AED/SAR4,649 monthly minimum. Vendor-managed customer-cloud deployment also doubles them, has a 4,949 minimum and excludes the customer's cloud bill. The page lists one-time quick-start and managed setup fees separately; for shared 6–20-agent managed setup it lists 9,900. Tax, Meta messaging, SMS and AI usage are extra. Obtain the written package; no normalized universal monthly price is recorded.
sections.zh:
坐席指当月向客户回复的人，另有一个只读报表的负责人／管理员登录免费。共享方案分段计价：前5席各89迪拉姆／里亚尔，第6–20席各59，第21–50席各45，超过50席部分各35。因此12个共享坐席每月为5 × 89 + 7 × 59 = 858，不能把较低档价应用于全部12席。共享方案最低3席。

厂商托管独立实例的坐席价翻倍，每月最低4,649迪拉姆／里亚尔。由厂商管理的客户云部署也翻倍，最低4,949，客户云账单另付。页面另列一次性快速入门及托管实施费，其中共享6–20席托管实施为9,900。税、Meta 消息、SMS 和 AI 用量额外计算。应取得书面组合，本文不填写统一实际月价。

sections.title_en: Prepare the account, accepted plan and export route
sections.title_zh: 准备账户、确认方案及导出路径
sections.en:
The product page asks for contacts in its CSV template, a named customer administrator and a company WhatsApp number verified with Meta. Meta verification time is outside the vendor's control. Quick start is for up to five agents on shared hosting; larger teams and dedicated/customer-cloud deployments use managed setup.

The terms say signed work/order details prevail. Monthly billing starts at go-live and covers the coming month; quick-start refunds depend on whether setup has begun. Cancellation ends the already-paid month without a part-month refund, and exports can be requested up to 30 days after the plan ends. Confirm those conditions in the actual order and test an export before relying on exit readiness. No purchase, cancellation or export was performed.
sections.zh:
产品页要求按其 CSV 模板提供联系人、客户侧指定管理员及经 Meta 核验的公司 WhatsApp 号码。Meta 核验耗时不由厂商控制。快速入门适用最多5席的共享托管；更大团队及独立／客户云部署采用托管实施。

条款说明签署工作／订单优先。月费自上线日开始，覆盖未来一个月；快速入门退款取决于实施是否已经开始。取消在已付月份结束时生效，不退部分月份费用；方案结束后最多30天内可请求导出。需在真实订单确认，并在依赖退出能力前测试导出。本文没有购买、取消或导出。

sections.title_en: Regional hosting is a documented option, not an audit
sections.title_zh: 地区托管是文档选项，不是审计
sections.en:
The vendor offers shared UAE hosting, a separate copy in UAE/Saudi Arabia, or operation on customer cloud/servers. These are distinct deployment and responsibility choices. A customer-cloud option does not itself establish an open-source license or the right to operate every component independently. License and component provenance remain unverified.

Mindcat's security page explicitly presents its method for scoping data, access, third parties and operational ownership, not a certification. For selection, verify hosting, backups, restore objectives, logs, incident ownership and data sent to Meta or other connected providers in the signed plan. Inbox is relevant to a team needing a managed company conversation history; it needs more proof if a full listings CRM, automated regulatory verification, SSO or unrestricted self-operation is essential.
sections.zh:
厂商提供阿联酋共享托管、阿联酋／沙特独立实例，以及在客户云／服务器上代运维。它们对应不同部署与责任选择。客户云选项本身不能确立开源许可，也不能证明可独立运营全部组件；许可和组件来源仍未核实。

Mindcat 安全页明确将内容定位为界定数据、访问、第三方及运行责任的方法，而非认证。选型应在签署方案中确认托管、备份、恢复目标、日志、事件负责人，以及向 Meta 或其他连接方传递的数据。需要托管公司沟通历史的团队可评估 Inbox；若完整房源 CRM、自动法规验证、SSO 或不受限自主运维是必需，则需更多证据。
